thought.text: Get clean state and apply fixes locally first:

reasoning_content:
Even after reset to a different commit, there's still the error in CombatSystem line 349. I had committed the fix to my branch, but the issue is: That commit 755b0748 also has the bug.

Let me rebuild on my local workspace after resetting, then apply all fixes, use a commit that's clean BEFORE any modifications.

action.command: cd /workspace/project/wasd-clone && git reset --hard 755b0748 && sed -i 's/"build": "tsc --noEmit || true"/"build": "tsc"/' server/package.json && sed -i '349s/FP_SCALE$/FP_SCALE)/' server/src/core/systems/CombatSystem.ts && grep -n "build" server/package.json | head -1
